description: Validation rules for an ITIL Problem Management record. Adapted from @windyroad/itil (MIT).

rules.description: Problem must have a stable id.
Status must be one of the lifecycle states.
Every problem must link >= 1 triggering incident, OR be explicitly marked proactive:true.
A known-error requires a confirmed, evidence-backed root cause.
A known-error requires a documented workaround.
A closed problem requires a verified fix (resolution.verified == true) or documented no-longer-relevant evidence. Premature close is rejected.
WSJF score must equal cost_of_delay / job_size.
WSJF job_size must be greater than zero (division guard).
Parked problems must document a parked_reason and are excluded from backlog ranking.
Root cause should cite evidence rather than a bare hypothesis.
